# Vendored third-party code

## svg-pan-zoom.min.js

- Project: svg-pan-zoom 3.6.2, https://github.com/bumbu/svg-pan-zoom
- Source: `dist/svg-pan-zoom.min.js` from the npm package `svg-pan-zoom@3.6.2` (`npm pack svg-pan-zoom@3.6.2`), unmodified
- Licence: BSD-2-Clause, see `svg-pan-zoom.LICENSE`. The same text is embedded in every generated viewer.
- Used by `infradiag.viewer`, which inlines it so each viewer works offline.

To update, replace both files from the new npm package and change the version here.
